items: A QA run that records one package per case keeps every case's verdicts: each acceptance criterion binds to the case that proved it
Releasing or recycling a slot whose run failed completion is refused, so the checkout a completion replay needs is kept; replay the completion or discard the workspace with the named force release
QA can prepare at a frozen release-range head after the release branch has moved, including on a detached slot
Idle resource cleanup finds and stops simulators and dev servers that disabled slots left running, and confirms each stop with a fresh probe
A run whose refused completion was discarded no longer counts as active or owns its PR, so a new run can start on that PR
